170.hindi_meaning: लगन, परिश्रम और सावधानीपूर्वक किया गया कार्य।
170.example: With hard work and diligence, she passed the difficult exam.

170.english_meaning: Continued effort to do or achieve something despite difficulties.
170.hindi_meaning: कठिनाइयों के बावजूद लगातार प्रयास करते रहना और हार न मानना (दृढ़ता)।

170.english_meaning: Pointlessness or uselessness of a task or action.

170.example: A good leader must have empathy for team members.

171.english_meaning: A strong desire to know or learn something.

171.english_meaning: Too powerful to be defeated or overcome.

171.english_meaning: Firm continuance in a course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition.

172.english_meaning: Concerned with works of literature such as novels, poems, and plays.
172.example: The textbook includes many interesting literary pieces for students.

172.english_meaning: To gradually put an idea or attitude into someone's mind.

172.example: Sports teach children resilience after a loss.

172.hindi_meaning: सहानुभूति या दूसरों की भावना समझना
172.example: Reading stories helps children develop empathy for others.

172.example: The book had a profound impact on his personal growth.

172.english_meaning: Involving or based on experience and practical learning.
172.example: Experiential learning helps students understand concepts better.

172.english_meaning: Showing or representing something through a drawing, picture, or words.
172.example: The illustrations are designed depicting the context of the story.

172.english_meaning: The evaluation or estimation of the nature, quality, or ability of someone or something.
172.example: Regular assessment helps teachers track student progress.

173.english_meaning: The head of a university or an important educational organization.
173.hindi_meaning: कुलपति या किसी उच्च शिक्षा संस्थान का प्रमुख
173.example: The Chancellor presided over the annual university meeting.

173.english_meaning: A person who leads a committee, meeting, or organization.

173.hindi_meaning: संगीतकार या किसी कला में अत्यंत निपुण व्यक्ति

175.english_meaning: A university teacher of the highest rank.
175.hindi_meaning: विश्वविद्यालय के उच्चतम स्तर के शिक्षक या प्राध्यापक।

175.english_meaning: A specialized division of a large organization, such as a government or university.
175.hindi_meaning: विभाग (किसी संस्था, सरकार या विश्वविद्यालय का एक विशिष्ट अंग)।

175.english_meaning: A person who provides expert advice professionally.

175.english_meaning: A person who ranks below a senior person and helps them in their work.
175.hindi_meaning: सहायक (जो वरिष्ठ व्यक्ति की सहायता करता है)।

175.english_meaning: A person who is in charge of an organization, department, or institution.

175.english_meaning: A person who assesses, examines, or evaluates something, such as a book or curriculum.
175.hindi_meaning: समीक्षक (जो किसी सामग्री, पुस्तक या पाठ्यक्रम की जांच और मूल्यांकन करता है)।

175.hindi_meaning_example: समीक्षकों के पैनल ने पाठ्यपुस्तकों की सावधानीपूर्वक जांच की।

175.english_meaning: An endowed institution established for a charitable, educational, or research purpose.
175.hindi_meaning: फाउंडेशन या संस्था (जो शैक्षिक या सामाजिक कार्यों के लिए स्थापित की गई हो)।
175.example: Anurag Behar is the CEO of the Azim Premji Foundation.
175.hindi_meaning_example: अनुराग बेहर अजीम प्रेमजी फाउंडेशन के सीईओ हैं।

175.english_meaning: A group of people appointed for a specific function, typically consisting of members of a larger group.
175.hindi_meaning: समिति (विशेष कार्य के लिए बनाई गई लोगों की मंडली)।
175.example: She is a member of the National Curriculum Framework Oversight Committee.
175.hindi_meaning_example: वह राष्ट्रीय पाठ्यचर्या रूपरेखा निगरानी समिति की सदस्या हैं।

175.hindi_meaning_example: मीरा भार्गव हॉफस्ट्रा विश्वविद्यालय में प्रोफेसर एमेरिटस हैं।
